title: Butterfly wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- wings -->
    <ellipse cx="30" cy="40" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#ff6fb5"/>
    <ellipse cx="70" cy="40" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#ff6fb5"/>
    <ellipse cx="32" cy="64" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#ffb3d9"/>
    <ellipse cx="68" cy="64" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#ffb3d9"/>
    <!-- wing spots -->
    <circle cx="24" cy="38" r="5" fill="#7be0ff"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="38" r="5" fill="#7be0ff"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#fff59d"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#fff59d"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="7" ry="26" fill="#5b4bb7"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="27" r="9" fill="#8b7be8"/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <path d="M45 20 Q40 10 34 8" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M55 20 Q60 10 66 8" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="8" r="2.5" fill="#ffd54f"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="8" r="2.5" fill="#ffd54f"/>
    <!-- sunglasses -->
    <rect x="37" y="24" width="11" height="8" rx="3" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
    <rect x="52" y="24" width="11" height="8" rx="3" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
    <rect x="47.5" y="26.5" width="5" height="2.5" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
    <path d="M37.5 26 l3-1.5" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M52.5 26 l3-1.5" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M46 33 Q50 36 54 33" stroke="#fff59d" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
